author: RamSet
releaseNotes: 0.19.10 - Auto-recovery fix: in rare cases a dropped session could stay dead until you opened the device and hit Save. The reconnect backstop trusted an internal 'live' flag that a stalled session could leave stuck on, so it never noticed the session was actually dead. It now also checks whether data is still flowing, and reconnects a session that's gone quiet despite the flag — so the thermostat heals itself without any manual step. Also hardened a reconnect path that could give up without retrying when the device's port needed re-discovering. (0.19.9 made routine reconnects info-level instead of warnings.)
